blockers: Incorrect play still reaches the same successful completion path: after two wrong submissions, done-partial's 「先へ進む」 calls onComplete; Q1Screen then unconditionally records the experience as completed and shows the same discovery/resolution screen used for a correct answer. Thus submitting incorrectly twice still guarantees completion and success-framed progression after one extra click, violating Gate H.
high: Wrong-answer consequence is predominantly text-only: the first miss merely displays a note, and the terminal partial outcome uses explanatory text/static symbols without a patient or clinical-world state change. This fails the binding WORLD_FEEDBACK_QUALITY/TEXT_ONLY_CONSEQUENCE requirement and weakens Gate F.

recommended_actions: Give onComplete an explicit outcome such as "success" or "partial", and ensure the partial route does not call completeExperience or enter the same celebratory resolution/discovery state as correct play.
Provide a distinct partial handoff or retry/restart route whose downstream framing preserves the unresolved assessment and does not award successful completion.
Add visible clinical-world feedback for incorrect reports—for example, an unresolved triage/report state or patient/team reaction—while retaining the nonspecific first-attempt retry prompt.
Add an integration test asserting that two incorrect submissions plus advancing from done-partial cannot record successful completion or render the success resolution.
